ground_truth.sat_reason: Originally UNSAT because: Cycle conflict across variables, forming a logical loop that cannot be satisfied: (¬x(0, 0, 0) ∨ x(2, 2, 1)), (¬x(2, 2, 1) ∨ x(0, 1, 0)), (¬x(0, 1, 0) ∨ x(2, 1, 0)), (¬x(2, 1, 0) ∨ x(0, 0, 1)), (¬x(0, 0, 1) ∨ x(0, 2, 0)), (¬x(0, 2, 0) ∨ x(2, 2, 0)), (¬x(2, 2, 0) ∨ x(1, 1, 0)), (¬x(1, 1, 0) ∨ x(2, 0, 1)), (¬x(2, 0, 1) ∨ x(3, 0, 1)), (¬x(3, 0, 1) ∨ ¬x(0, 0, 0)), (x(0, 0, 0)). After removing clause (¬x(2, 2, 0) ∨ x(1, 1, 0)), the conflict is resolved, making the problem satisfiable.
